source: Seeded from the approved VINTONE plan evidence; runtime binding must confirm against the active document.

workflow.name: Composite
workflow.summary: Drop source art into COMPOSITE so the processing chain live-dithers it to black and white.

workflow.name: Dither
workflow.summary: Open CHOOSE DITHER PATTERN, toggle pattern layers, save, and close the smart object.

workflow.name: Color
workflow.summary: Paint each color group's PAINT IN MASK layer while color overlay defines the ink color.

signatureAnchors.match: root group name includes VINTONE, with trademark suffix tolerated
group named COLORS under the VINTONE root
smart object named CHOOSE DITHER PATTERN
texture group containing worn plastisol samples when present
user artwork drop target with BLACK BG and WHITE BG background controls

bindingRules: Match by structure and layer shape, not exact color-slot names.
Treat PROCESSING and red/locked layers as read-only.
A color slot is a group under COLOR COMPOSITION with a BUFFER group, at least one PAINT IN MASK layer, and a color-overlay style.
Real sample files may rename color slots to semantic names and may include more than one PAINT IN MASK layer.
Dither pattern internals must be discovered by opening the smart object; do not hardcode internal layer names.
